what.text: This page follows refugees from Albania living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1560 Albanian refugees in the United States, 7.3% of all refugees from Albania.
France hosts the most Albanian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Albania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2001 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 295 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 7792, at the end of 2006, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
